{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_020_field_ideal_eq_bot_or_top {F : Type*} [Field F] (I : Ideal F) :
    I = 0 ∨ I = ⊤ := by
  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h
  · -- Case: I ≠ 0
    -- Since I is not the zero ideal, there exists a non-zero element in I
    have hI : I ≠ ⊥ := by simpa using h
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx_ne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
    -- In a field, every non-zero element is a unit
    have hx_unit : IsUnit x := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact hx_ne
    -- The ideal generated by a unit is the whole ring
    have h_span : Ideal.span {x} = ⊤ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
      exact hx_unit
    -- Since x ∈ I, the ideal generated by x is contained in I
    have h_span_le : Ideal.span {x} ≤ I := Ideal.span_le.mpr (fun y hy => by
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rw [hy]
      exact hx)
    -- Therefore, ⊤ ≤ I, which implies I = ⊤
    have h_top : I = ⊤ := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact I.le_top
      · exact h_span_le.trans h_span.symm
    exact Or.inr h_top"}

  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h

    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx_ne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI

    have h_span : Ideal.span {x} = ⊤ := by
